items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: The wife, a Mistress Bailey, taught him to read and write.

ctx.x: My father was born in Quitman, Mississippi, November 29, 1864. The year before the surrender he always told it. He was the youngest of seven. At four years old his mother passed, not knowing who or what his father was; a white family took him in in their home.

The wife, a Mistress Bailey, taught him to read and write. At the age of twelve or thirteen he had to leave the white family and he started living with his older brothers and their children, who were about his same age.
